name: QAWiki-derived English Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark
description: English benchmark subset derived from QAWiki-style entity and relation materials. The file contains 150 benchmark items, each with four related questions and an auxiliary relation-type code used during construction.

rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of large language models for semantic consistency across related question rewrites.
Analysis of answer-set equivalence and partition behavior on knowledge-base-style QA questions.
Not recommended as a broad-coverage factual QA training set.
rai:dataBiases: Coverage is shaped by publicly documented entities and relations, so it may under-represent less documented regions, languages, or communities.
The relation templates used during construction may make some consistency patterns cleaner than naturally occurring user queries.
rai:dataLimitations: The subset is small and diagnostic rather than comprehensive.
Relation labels reflect intended set-theoretic structure and do not eliminate all pragmatic ambiguity in natural language.
The English-only release does not support multilingual claims.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The released file contains benchmark questions only and is not intended to include personal or sensitive user data.
rai:dataSocialImpact: This subset may help improve robustness and consistency auditing for QA systems. Misuse would include overstating its scope as a general benchmark for safety, fairness, or overall truthfulness.
